name: m4-localopt-narrow
description: Does analyzing a method only when a pass has a question for it save compile time? Answers lrytz's [review comment](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11350#pullrequestreview-5754772227). Compiles pekko with `-opt:l:inline`; warmup from `m4-localopt-pilot`.

variantDescriptions.stack: [scala/scala#11350](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11350), [#11352](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11352) and [#11353](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11353) together: box-unbox and stale stores force the shared analysis on every method with an instruction or a call.
variantDescriptions.stack-aa: The same commit as `stack`, built from its own checkout: the A/A noise floor.
variantDescriptions.narrow: The stack plus the narrowing: box-unbox and the `ClassTag` check ask for the analysis only once an instruction matches. Output is byte-identical; analyses fall 61% and instructions analysed 27% on pekko.
